_about: Is this turn asking for something, or remarking on something?
The router's own request_explicitness field comes back 'direct' for
every input measured, so _REQUEST_SHAPE in brain/intent_router.py reads
the shape of the sentence instead. When a turn the model wanted to look
up does NOT have a request shape, the lookup is withheld and offered.
It was written for English, where a question fronts its wh-word or
inverts its auxiliary. Korean does neither: the question word stays
where the answer would go (wh-in-situ), and spoken Korean arrives from
Whisper without a question mark. Measured in runtime/koreanSession2.log,
three plain questions were read as remarks and answered from memory --
one of them with an invented viewer count.
Both halves matter. A remark read as a request is the failure the test
was written for ('Spotify won't play anything today.' -> a web search).
expect  request = has the shape of asking
